messages:
Lina: Quick sync — need final input for the partner-tiering revamp before QBR next Wed. Also reallocating MDF pilot for hardware partners. Who can pull scorecards + FYTD MDF spend?
Jasper: I can pull scorecards. Need the template — is the new KPI set finalized? cc @Priya for MDF numbers.
Priya: Finance can share spend by partner tomorrow EOD. Should I include committed runway + unallocated? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya: Adding ops perspective: can we tie tiers to usage + marketplace listings? Proposed columns: ARR_influence, integration_depth, go_to_market_motion, MDR.
Diego: Agree. Also want to test a pooled MDF bucket for 3 HW partners pilot. Limits: $80k/month, auto-expire 90d. Thoughts?
Jasper: Sounds good. For the scorecard, can we use this CSV layout?
Jasper: ```
partner,tier,contracted_arr,mdf_spend_to_date,marketplace_listings,si_integrations,computed_score
AcmeHW,Gold,120000,32000,2,1,78
``` 
Lina: Link to raw exports: https://drive.redwood/partners/qbr/2026-tier-revamp — everyone drop edits in the 'inputs' sheet by Tue noon.
Priya: Will do. Finance needs a decision on MDF amortization method — immediate expense vs committed reserve. Need a call by Tue COB.
Maya: :eyes: Product ops — can you weigh in on integration_depth scoring? Jasper, Diego?
Diego: I'll add notes on SI integrations. Small vs large SI should be different buckets.
calendar-bot: Scheduled "Partner Tier Sync" for 2026-03-24 10:00 PDT. Invite sent to Lina, Jasper, Maya, Priya, Diego.
Lina: Agenda: 1) Scorecards + data gaps 2) MDF pilot rules 3) Tier mapping + marketplace triggers. Prep: bring partner examples. :thumbsup:
Jasper: I'll upload scorecard exports by EOD today. Quick Q: do we include usage from trial accounts? That skews ARR.
Priya: Exclude trials; use contracted ARR only.
Diego: One more ask — can we flag partners with pending PR/announcement windows? MDF tied to marketing calendar would help.
Maya: Good call. I'll add a 'launch_window' column.
Lina: Thanks team. If no blockers I'll convert this into an action list after the meeting.
